label: batch-86
tail:
Completed batch 86: four A-page items, one B example, both pages, and the batch evidence. I added a local finite-response lemma because the existing response result did not cover arbitrary observables.

The high-temperature theorem proves the covariance-sum response and a finite spatial-average variance/Chebyshev bound. It does not claim exponential concentration or analyticity.
